evals.name: Lists the breaking change
evals.prompt:
Read `CHANGELOG.md` and write ${count} release notes.
Mind the $ sign.
evals.expected_output: A short note naming the breaking change.

assertions: The summary reads as though a maintainer wrote it, not a machine.

evals.name: Only prose
evals.prompt: Explain the change to a new reader.
assertions: It avoids jargon a first-week reader would not know.
It says why the change was made, not only what changed.
